name: Flesh to Stone

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

targets.description: a creature you can see within range

summary: Con save or the target is Restrained as it starts turning to stone.
text: A Restrained target repeats the save at the end of each of its turns: three successes end the spell, three failures leave it Petrified. If you keep Concentration for the full minute, the petrification lasts until removed.
